name: AVEDEV
summary: Returns the average of the absolute deviations of data points from their mean.

name: AVERAGE
summary: Returns the arithmetic mean of its arguments.

name: AVERAGEA
summary: Returns the average of its arguments, counting text in ranges as 0 and logicals as 1 or 0.

name: AVERAGEIF
summary: Returns the average of the cells that meet a criterion.

name: AVERAGEIFS
summary: Returns the average of the cells that meet several criteria.

name: BETA.DIST
summary: Returns the beta distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: BETA.INV
summary: Returns the inverse of the cumulative beta distribution.

args.name: probability
args.description: A probability of the beta distribution.

name: BINOM.DIST
summary: Returns the individual term binomial distribution probability.

args.name: probability_s
args.description: The probability of success on each trial.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for at most number_s successes, FALSE for exactly.

name: BINOM.DIST.RANGE
summary: Returns the probability of a trial result using a binomial distribution.

args.name: number_s2
args.description: If given, the upper bound of a range of successes.

name: BINOM.INV
summary: Returns the smallest value for which the cumulative binomial distribution is greater than or equal to a criterion value.

name: CHISQ.DIST
summary: Returns the chi-squared distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: CHISQ.DIST.RT
summary: Returns the right-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

name: CHISQ.INV
summary: Returns the inverse of the left-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

name: CHISQ.INV.RT
summary: Returns the inverse of the right-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

name: CHISQ.TEST
summary: Returns the test for independence (the chi-squared probability).

name: CONFIDENCE.NORM
summary: Returns the confidence interval half-width for a population mean, using a normal distribution.

name: CONFIDENCE.T
summary: Returns the confidence interval half-width for a population mean, using a Student's t distribution.

name: CORREL
summary: Returns the correlation coefficient of two data sets.

name: COUNT
summary: Counts the cells that contain numbers.

name: COUNTA
summary: Counts the cells that are not empty.

name: COUNTBLANK
summary: Counts the empty cells in a range (cells with "" count too).

args.name: range
args.description: The range to count blanks in.

name: COUNTIF
summary: Counts the cells that meet a criterion.

args.name: criteria
args.description: A number, expression or text such as 32, ">32", "apples" or "a*".

name: COUNTIFS
summary: Counts the cells that meet several criteria.

name: COVARIANCE.P
summary: Returns population covariance, the average of the products of paired deviations.

name: COVARIANCE.S
summary: Returns the sample covariance.

name: DEVSQ
summary: Returns the sum of squares of deviations from the sample mean.

name: EXPON.DIST
summary: Returns the exponential distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: F.DIST
summary: Returns the F probability distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: F.DIST.RT
summary: Returns the right-tailed F probability distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

name: F.INV
summary: Returns the inverse of the F probability distribution.

name: F.INV.RT
summary: Returns the inverse of the right-tailed F probability distribution.

name: F.TEST
summary: Returns the result of an F-test: the two-tailed probability that the variances are not significantly different.

name: FISHER
summary: Returns the Fisher transformation.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

name: FISHERINV
summary: Returns the inverse of the Fisher transformation.

name: FORECAST.LINEAR
summary: Predicts a value along a linear trend from existing values.

args.name: x
args.description: The data point to predict a value for.

name: FREQUENCY
summary: Counts how often values occur within ranges of values and returns a vertical array.

name: GAMMA
summary: Returns the gamma function value.

name: GAMMA.DIST
summary: Returns the gamma distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: beta
args.description: A parameter of the distribution (1 gives the standard gamma).

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: GAMMA.INV
summary: Returns the inverse of the gamma cumulative distribution.

name: GAMMALN
summary: Returns the natural logarithm of the gamma function.

name: GAMMALN.PRECISE
summary: Returns the natural logarithm of the gamma function.

name: GAUSS
summary: Returns the probability that a standard normal value falls between the mean and z standard deviations from it.

name: GEOMEAN
summary: Returns the geometric mean.

name: GROWTH
summary: Returns values along an exponential trend.

args.name: new_x's
args.description: The x values to return y for.

name: HARMEAN
summary: Returns the harmonic mean.

name: HYPGEOM.DIST
summary: Returns the hypergeometric distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: INTERCEPT
summary: Returns the intercept of the linear regression line.

name: KURT
summary: Returns the kurtosis of a data set.

name: LARGE
summary: Returns the k-th largest value in a data set.

name: LINEST
summary: Returns the parameters of a linear trend (and optionally regression statistics).

name: LOGEST
summary: Returns the parameters of an exponential trend.

name: LOGNORM.DIST
summary: Returns the lognormal distribution of x.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: LOGNORM.INV
summary: Returns the inverse of the lognormal cumulative distribution.

name: MAX
summary: Returns the largest number in a set of values.

name: MAXA
summary: Returns the largest value, counting logicals and text in ranges.

name: MAXIFS
summary: Returns the largest value among cells that meet criteria.

args.name: max_range
args.description: The cells to take the maximum of.

name: MEDIAN
summary: Returns the median of the given numbers.

name: MIN
summary: Returns the smallest number in a set of values.

name: MINA
summary: Returns the smallest value, counting logicals and text in ranges.

name: MINIFS
summary: Returns the smallest value among cells that meet criteria.

args.name: min_range
args.description: The cells to take the minimum of.

name: MODE.MULT
summary: Returns a vertical array of the most frequently occurring values.

name: MODE.SNGL
summary: Returns the most frequently occurring value.

name: NEGBINOM.DIST
summary: Returns the negative binomial distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: NORM.DIST
summary: Returns the normal distribution for a mean and standard deviation.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: NORM.INV
summary: Returns the inverse of the normal cumulative distribution.

name: NORM.S.DIST
summary: Returns the standard normal distribution (mean 0, standard deviation 1).

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: NORM.S.INV
summary: Returns the inverse of the standard normal cumulative distribution.

name: PEARSON
summary: Returns the Pearson product moment correlation coefficient.

name: PERCENTILE.EXC
summary: Returns the k-th percentile of values, where k is in the open range 0..1.

args.name: k
args.description: The percentile value, exclusive of 0 and 1.

name: PERCENTILE.INC
summary: Returns the k-th percentile of values, where k is in the range 0..1 inclusive.

name: PERCENTRANK.EXC
summary: Returns the rank of a value in a data set as a percentage (0..1, exclusive).

name: PERCENTRANK.INC
summary: Returns the rank of a value in a data set as a percentage (0..1, inclusive).

name: PERMUT
summary: Returns the number of permutations for a given number of objects.

args.name: number_chosen
args.description: The number of objects in each permutation.

name: PERMUTATIONA
summary: Returns the number of permutations (with repetitions) for a given number of objects.

args.name: number_chosen
args.description: The number of objects in each permutation.

name: PHI
summary: Returns the value of the density function for a standard normal distribution.

name: POISSON.DIST
summary: Returns the Poisson distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: PROB
summary: Returns the probability that values in a range are between two limits.

args.name: prob_range
args.description: Probabilities for each value in x_range.

name: QUARTILE.EXC
summary: Returns the quartile of a data set, based on percentile values from 0..1, exclusive.

name: QUARTILE.INC
summary: Returns the quartile of a data set, based on percentile values from 0..1, inclusive.

args.name: quart
args.description: 0 minimum, 1 first quartile, 2 median, 3 third quartile, 4 maximum.

name: RANK.AVG
summary: Returns the rank of a number in a list; ties get the average rank.

args.name: order
args.description: 0 or omitted for descending, non-zero for ascending.

name: RANK.EQ
summary: Returns the rank of a number in a list; ties get the top rank.

args.name: order
args.description: 0 or omitted for descending, non-zero for ascending.

name: RSQ
summary: Returns the square of the Pearson correlation coefficient.

name: SKEW
summary: Returns the skewness of a distribution.

name: SKEW.P
summary: Returns the skewness of a distribution based on a population.

name: SLOPE
summary: Returns the slope of the linear regression line.

name: SMALL
summary: Returns the k-th smallest value in a data set.

name: STANDARDIZE
summary: Returns a normalised value from a distribution with the given mean and standard deviation.

name: STDEV.P
summary: Calculates the standard deviation of an entire population.

name: STDEV.S
summary: Estimates the standard deviation of a sample.

name: STDEVA
summary: Estimates standard deviation from a sample, counting text and logicals.

name: STDEVPA
summary: Calculates the population standard deviation, counting text and logicals.

name: STEYX
summary: Returns the standard error of the predicted y-value for each x in the regression.

name: T.DIST
summary: Returns the left-tailed Student's t-distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: T.DIST.2T
summary: Returns the two-tailed Student's t-distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

name: T.DIST.RT
summary: Returns the right-tailed Student's t-distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

name: T.INV
summary: Returns the left-tailed inverse of the Student's t-distribution.

name: T.INV.2T
summary: Returns the two-tailed inverse of the Student's t-distribution.

name: T.TEST
summary: Returns the probability associated with a Student's t-test.

args.name: type
args.description: 1 paired, 2 two-sample equal variance, 3 two-sample unequal variance.

name: TREND
summary: Returns values along a linear trend.

args.name: new_x's
args.description: The x values to return y for.

name: TRIMMEAN
summary: Returns the mean of the interior of a data set, excluding a percentage of points from the top and bottom.

args.name: percent
args.description: The fraction of points to exclude.

name: VAR.P
summary: Calculates variance based on the entire population.

name: VAR.S
summary: Estimates variance based on a sample.

name: VARA
summary: Estimates variance from a sample, counting text and logicals.

name: VARPA
summary: Calculates variance of an entire population, counting text and logicals.

name: WEIBULL.DIST
summary: Returns the Weibull distribution.

args.name: x
args.description: The value at which to evaluate the distribution.

args.name: cumulative
args.description: TRUE for the cumulative distribution function, FALSE for the density (or mass) function.

name: Z.TEST
summary: Returns the one-tailed probability-value of a z-test.

args.name: array
args.description: The data to test against x.

args.name: sigma
args.description: The population standard deviation (default: the sample standard deviation).
